title: SAS Viya Report Load Time p95
app: SAS Viya audit and job-execution logs via the SAS Logging service to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=sas:viya:audit state="completed"
| eval dur_s=round(duration_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by report_name
| where p95_s>10
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile load time for each report in SAS Viya and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking SAS Viya reports by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest SAS Viya timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest reports with their owners.
visualization: Table of report by p95 load time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in SAS Viya so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
